sections.heading: What is organic MCT oil powder
paragraphs: MCT oil powder is medium-chain triglyceride oil turned into a dry, free-flowing powder. Ours is made by spray-drying organic medium-chain triglycerides with organic tapioca fiber. It supplies the C8 and C10 fatty acids that MCT oil is known for.
Manufacturers choose the powder because it avoids the handling problems of liquid oil. It disperses well, blends into dry mixes, and can be filled and packed on standard powder lines.
